answer: Seed every grader's queue with a few planted answers whose quality is already known: some careful, some a plausible fable stuffed with factual errors. A sybil farm that rubber-stamps its own members tends to rubber-stamp everything, so its graders praise the planted junk too. Each miss shrinks that grader's weight, and an identity that keeps failing these checks ends up on an island where its scores no longer move anyone's rewards. Honest graders crack each walnut open and find the flaw; lazy clones never look inside.
